title: First principles
subtitle: 01 / Gravity & direction
description: Guide the orange ball into the green receiver. Place the two ramps to build a path through the air.
hint: Start with a gentle slope below the ball. Use the second ramp to continue the journey toward the receiver.

presentation.title: First principles
presentation.task: Guide the orange ball into the green receiver. Place the two ramps to build a path through the air.
presentation.hint: Start with a gentle slope below the ball. Use the second ramp to continue the journey toward the receiver.
presentation.status: Place and rotate both ramps. Manual placement; physical nudging is not yet supported.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Ramp placement remains manual.

title: A little lightbulb moment
subtitle: 11 / Impact & power
description: Use a switch to turn on the signal lamp. Place it under the bowling ball, then connect the switch to the lamp.
hint: Select the switch, choose Connect, then click the lamp. The cable shows where the power will go.

title: Air mail
subtitle: 11a / Air & mass
description: Carry the little tennis ball into the receiver with a fan. Air pushes a light ball much more than a heavy one.
hint: Put the fan just to the left of the falling ball. Height matters: a short gust is often enough.

title: Spring forward
subtitle: 02 / Stored energy
description: Catch the falling ball's energy in a springboard and return it toward the basket.
hint: Place the springboard below the ball and tilt it clockwise. Compression stores some of the fall's energy; release sends the ball toward the lower basket.

presentation.title: Spring forward
presentation.task: Catch the falling ball’s energy in a springboard and return it toward the receiver.
presentation.hint: Tilt the springboard toward the receiver. Let the falling ball compress it, or add initial compression near the ball for a finite launch.
presentation.status: Place and tilt the springboard. Initial compression is optional stored energy; release needs no wire.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: A different perspective
subtitle: 11b / Think in depth
description: The receiver is in front of the ball. Orbit the camera, change the work plane, and rotate a fan to move the ball through depth.
hint: The ball starts at depth -2; the receiver is at +2. Turn the fan 90° around its vertical axis. Right-drag to inspect.

title: The domino effect
subtitle: 04 / Chain reactions
description: Make the fixed end domino fall. Fill the gap with four dominoes.
hint: Stand the tiles on a surface and leave gaps short enough for each falling tile to hit the next.

presentation.title: The domino effect
presentation.task: Make the fixed end domino fall and light the lamp. Fill the gap with four dominoes and connect the end domino to the lamp.
presentation.hint: Stand four tiles between the ball and the fixed end domino, one metre apart, so each falling tile strikes the next. Connect the end domino to the lamp.
presentation.status: Stand the four dominoes between the ball and the end domino, then connect the end domino to the lamp.
presentation.precision_status: Difficulty recorded. Domino placement remains manual.

title: Spring-loaded signal
subtitle: 11c / Motion into power
description: Return the falling ball toward the lower switch and light the lamp.
hint: Tilt the spring clockwise. Remember the wire from switch to lamp.

title: Cold start
subtitle: 11d / Causal machines
description: The fan starts off. Use the bowling ball to power it before the tennis ball falls past.
hint: A switch close beneath the bowling ball starts the fan early. Connect it to the fixed fan.

title: A little sidekick
subtitle: 05 / Round rebounds
description: Use the pinball bumper to bounce the orange ball into the receiver.
hint: The ball bounces away from the impact point. Put the bumper just left of the falling ball to send it right.

presentation.title: A little sidekick
presentation.task: Use the pinball bumper to bounce the orange ball into the receiver.
presentation.hint: Put the bumper just left of the falling ball to send it toward the receiver.
presentation.status: Place the bumper just left of the falling ball. Run tests the rebound; Reset lets you retry.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Bounce into depth
subtitle: 06 / Round rebounds
description: Send the ball across the workbench's depth with a round bumper.
hint: Orbit with Q/E to see the route. Offset the bumper toward the front so the ball rebounds toward the receiver behind it.

presentation.title: Bounce into depth
presentation.task: Use the bumper to bounce the ball through depth into the receiver.
presentation.hint: Use Q/E to orbit. Put the bumper in front of the falling ball to send it toward the receiver behind.
presentation.status: Orbit with Q/E and place the bumper in depth. Manual placement; physical nudging is not yet supported.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Build the rebound
subtitle: 07 / Build a barrier
description: Place both the launcher and its return wall to deliver the ball into the basket on the left.
hint: First offset the bumper slightly left of the falling ball. Then catch the rising flight with a tall wall to its right.

presentation.title: Build the rebound
presentation.task: Build a wall and bumper route to return the ball to the receiver.
presentation.hint: Resize and position the wall to return the bumper rebound toward the receiver.
presentation.status: Resize the wall and place the bumper to build the return route. Placement remains manual.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: A turn for the better
subtitle: 12 / Electrical supply
description: Make the motor complete a full turn. It needs a battery, not an activation signal.
hint: Place a battery, select it and choose Connect. Click the motor, then Run.

title: Close the circuit
subtitle: 12a / Switched supply
description: The motor must wait for the falling ball to trigger its supply switch, then complete a turn.
hint: Place the switch under the ball. Connect battery to switch, then switch to motor. A switch controls electricity but does not create it.

title: Conveyor courier
subtitle: 14a / Mechanical drive
description: Carry the ball on a motor-driven conveyor. A belt needs rotation, not an activation signal.
hint: Place the conveyor beneath the ball. Connect battery to motor, then motor to conveyor.

title: Pass the rotation
subtitle: 14b / Mechanical drive
description: Use the high conveyor's output pulley to drive the delivery conveyor below.
hint: Wire battery to motor. Belt the motor to the high conveyor, then connect that conveyor to your delivery belt.

title: The other way round
subtitle: 14c / Reverse transmission
description: The basket is to the left. Reverse the drive so the conveyor carries the ball back toward it.
hint: Wire battery to motor, then belt motor to reverse transmission and transmission to conveyor. Its paired wheels turn in opposite directions.

title: A helping weight
subtitle: 12b / Ropes and loads
description: Lift the small load into the overhead switch to light the lamp. A heavier weight can pull it upward.
hint: Place the larger weight high under the right pulley. Connect small load → left pulley → right pulley → large weight, then switch → lamp. Rope length is set when you connect.

title: The long way round
subtitle: 12c / Route a rope
description: The counterweight belongs in the front depth lane. Add a pulley above it and route the rope back to the small load.
hint: Place the second pulley above the large weight. Connect both pulleys into one continuous rope with a load at each end; a loose end cannot lift anything.

title: A little sunshine
subtitle: 51a / Light into electricity
description: Use the flashlight to supply the motor through a solar panel. The falling ball presses the torch's button.
hint: Put the panel in front of the cream lens, with blue cells facing the torch. Connect panel to motor; four gold meter marks mean enough light.

title: Out of the shade
subtitle: 51b / Light and obstacles
description: The wooden wall blocks the flashlight. Find a lit position for the panel and turn the motor.
hint: Keep the panel on the flashlight side of the wall, facing the lens. Wires carry electricity around obstacles, but light cannot pass through them.

title: Wait for it
subtitle: 23a / Delayed commands
description: Light the lamp only after the delay box finishes its countdown.
hint: Connect switch → delay → lamp. A trigger starts the one-second countdown; further triggers are ignored until Reset.

presentation.title: Wait for it
presentation.task: Light the lamp only after the delay box finishes its countdown.
presentation.hint: Connect the switch to the delay, then the delay to the lamp. A trigger starts the one-second countdown; further triggers are ignored until Reset.
presentation.status: Place the Delay and connect its activation sockets. Run tests the signal; Reset lets you retry.
presentation.precision_status: Switch sensitivity updated. Delay placement remains manual.

title: A later sunrise
subtitle: 51c / Timing and power
description: Wait for the countdown before lighting the torch and turning the motor.
hint: Connect switch → delay → torch, then panel → motor. The delay sends a command, while the lit solar panel supplies electricity.

title: Through the looking tube
subtitle: 21 / Hollow routes
description: Catch the falling ball inside the clear pipe and guide it down to the basket.
hint: Tilt the tube downhill toward the basket. Its cream mouths are open; the clear walls keep the ball inside without adding speed.

presentation.title: Through the looking tube
presentation.task: Catch the falling ball inside the clear pipe and guide it down to the basket.
presentation.hint: Tilt the tube downhill toward the basket. Its cream mouths are open; the clear walls keep the ball inside without adding speed.
presentation.status: Tilt the pipe downhill toward the basket. Run tests the passage; Reset lets you retry.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: A gentle turn
subtitle: 21a / Hollow routes
description: Guide the falling ball toward the basket with a 45-degree bend.
hint: Turn the first mouth upward under the ball. The second mouth sends it down and left; gravity carries it through the curve.

presentation.title: A gentle turn
presentation.task: Guide the falling ball toward the basket with a 45-degree bend.
presentation.hint: Turn the first mouth upward under the ball. The second mouth sends it down and left; gravity carries it through the curve.
presentation.status: Turn the first mouth upward under the ball. The second mouth sends it down and left; gravity carries it through the curve.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Around the corner
subtitle: 22 / Hollow routes
description: Use a 90-degree bend to turn a vertical fall into a sideways delivery.
hint: Point one mouth upward and the other toward the left-hand basket. The curve redirects motion, but does not add speed.

presentation.title: Around the corner
presentation.task: Use a 90-degree bend to turn a vertical fall into a sideways delivery.
presentation.hint: Point one mouth upward and the other toward the left-hand basket. The curve redirects motion, but does not add speed.
presentation.status: Point one mouth upward and the other toward the left-hand basket. The curve redirects motion, but does not add speed.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Meet in the middle
subtitle: 22a / Joined routes
description: Join a short straight tube to the fixed bend so the falling ball reaches the receiver.
hint: Shorten the tube to fit, turn it downhill, then bring its lower mouth near the bend's upper mouth. A small move aligns the openings; the ball needs a continuous route.

presentation.title: Meet in the middle
presentation.task: Join a short straight tube to the fixed bend so the falling ball reaches the receiver.
presentation.hint: Shorten the tube to fit, turn it downhill, then bring its lower mouth near the bend's upper mouth. A small move aligns the openings; the ball needs a continuous route.
presentation.status: Resize the pipe to fit, tilt it downhill, then move its lower mouth onto the bend's upper mouth.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Two deliveries
subtitle: 19a / Parallel machines
description: Catch both balls, one with ramps and one with air. The receivers are in separate depth planes.
hint: Work on one depth plane at a time; both goals must finish in the same run.

title: Double cold start
subtitle: 19b / Master workshop
description: Start a stopped conveyor and a cold fan, then finish a spring catch in a third lane.
hint: Wire one trigger switch to the belt and another to the fan. The fan needs power before its ball falls past.

title: One thing leads to another
subtitle: 20 / Final workshop
description: Complete the ramp signal, conveyor signal, and domino chain; all three must succeed in one run.
hint: Build and test each lane. The final machine needs two slopes, a conveyor delivery, four dominoes, and both signal wires.

title: Wind, then release
subtitle: 41 / Stored energy
description: Wind the spring, then release it to send the orange ball into the basket.
hint: Place the spring beneath the orange ball, leaning slightly toward the basket. Wire battery to motor, belt motor to spring, and connect switch to delay to spring. The signal releases energy; it does not supply it.

presentation.title: Wind, then release
presentation.task: Wind the spring, then release it to send the orange ball into the basket.
presentation.hint: Place the spring beneath the orange ball, leaning slightly toward the basket. Wire battery to motor, belt motor to spring, and connect switch to delay to spring. The signal releases energy; it does not supply it.
presentation.status: Place the spring, then connect winding power and a separate release signal.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver and switch assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: Saved for later
subtitle: 41a / Stored energy
description: Use a brief burst of motor power to wind the spring. Its stored energy can deliver the ball after the motor stops.
hint: Put a hold timer between battery and motor. Belt motor to spring. Connect switch to delay, then delay to both the timer and the three-second delay. Connect the three-second delay to the spring. Watch the motor stop before the latch opens.

presentation.title: Saved for later
presentation.task: Use a brief burst of motor power to wind the spring. Its stored energy can deliver the ball after the motor stops.
presentation.hint: Put a hold timer between battery and motor. Belt motor to spring. Connect switch to delay, then delay to both the timer and the three-second delay. Connect the three-second delay to the spring. Watch the motor stop before the latch opens.
presentation.status: Place the Hold timer, then connect timed winding power, the belt and the switch's release chain.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver and switch assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: A gentle rebound
subtitle: 03 / Elastic surfaces
description: Bounce the orange ball into the basket with one trampoline.
hint: Place the trampoline beneath the ball and tilt its surface toward the basket. It returns some of the falling ball's energy; it needs no motor or trigger.

title: Ready to rebound
subtitle: 03a / Energy already stored
description: This springboard is already compressed. Place a basket to catch the ball when its stored energy is released.
hint: Watch the ball's short upward arc, then put the basket beneath its descent. The spring releases on Run; it needs no wire and does not recharge itself.

presentation.title: Ready to rebound
presentation.task: Place a receiver to catch the ball when the compressed springboard releases on Run.
presentation.hint: The compressed springboard releases when Run begins. Place the receiver in the ball’s path.
presentation.status: The springboard starts compressed. Place the receiver beneath the ball’s descent.
presentation.precision_status: Receiver assistance updated. Placement remains manual.

title: A change of lift
subtitle: 09a / Impact & gas
description: Pop the rising balloon by placing the bowling ball above it.
hint: A strong impact opens the envelope. Gas escapes and the balloon falls.

presentation.title: A change of lift
presentation.task: Pop the rising balloon by placing the bowling ball above it.
presentation.hint: A strong impact opens the envelope. Gas escapes and the balloon falls.
presentation.status: Place the bowling ball above the balloon, then Run.
